text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that stopping be prohibited at all times on the south side of Ruddington Drive, between a point 126.2 metres east of Bayview Avenue and a point 37 metres further east. On-street parking in this area limits visibility when exiting the driveway to the midrise condominium at 17 Ruddington Drive. The proposed prohibition will address this issue. This will result in the loss of four parking spaces.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Ruddington Drive, between a point 126.2 metres east of Bayview Avenue and a point 37 metres further east.
